purpose: Attribute an unchanged BOT-RULE-101 equity curve to causal diagnostic regimes

lifecycle.idea: Explain the existing modelled loss by diagnostic regime without changing the robot
lifecycle.source: FQL-S6-REG-001 and the mandatory failure analysis by regime
lifecycle.hypothesis: Causal labels and equity points can be joined deterministically by timestamp
lifecycle.critique: Groups contain only 4 and 3 observations and cannot be compared statistically
lifecycle.decision: Accept timestamp join mechanics; reject regime-performance inference
lifecycle.lesson: Diagnostics may explain a fixed run but must not silently become a strategy input

limitations: only 7 labelled intervals and 2 observed groups
no inference, ranking or strategy selection is justified
verification: duplicate and unknown timestamps fail closed
lessons: Small regime buckets must not receive Sharpe or ranking claims
Any regime-aware robot requires a new registered hypothesis and OOS plan
